scope: Game-only H1 installation of LORD 1.2.0 on both recorded Waveshare 4.3 consoles; no Console OS partition or firmware was written.

console_os.installation_method: validated atomic P4G upload through H1 with native catalog hot reload

verification.host_before_delivery: focused sanitizer tests, SDL host tests, manifest registry, deterministic generator, and P4G package validation passed
verification.backend_sync: record codec present; Console OS realm adapter and server remain pending

operator_checklist: Open GAMES/ADVENTURE and launch LORD on each unit.
Create or load a hero and confirm town, inn, Seth, Violet, Dragon Dice, and ChompCoin wording render correctly.
Confirm D-pad, A, B, Start, touch controls, tones, and Back-to-launcher.
Exit and relaunch to check whether the current board storage policy exposes durable saves.
Do not classify backend synchronization as working until the realm adapter and server acceptance pass.
